sar.narrative: Customer C10990, holder of card C10990-K1, is the subject of this report due to suspicious transaction activity occurring on November 21, 2016. Between 16:00 and 16:24, four online transactions totaling $1,926.93 were executed on the card using device profile 'Windows |  | chrome 63.0 | ', which had one prior transaction on the card before the alert. The specific transactions included $477.19 (3475933 at 16:00), $484.81 (3475959 at 16:08), $468.87 (3475998 at 16:22), and $496.06 (3476008 at 16:24). This activity appeared suspicious because each amount was kept just under a $500 authorization threshold and placed within minutes of each other. Furthermore, the $468.87 transaction significantly exceeded the card's 95th percentile of $90.43 and median of $24.67. Although the case-memory model score was 0.10 with a feature profile not resembling confirmed-fraud closed cases from July to October, eight of the eight most similar closed cases (including CC-3841, CC-3907, CC-4124, and CC-4086) were confirmed fraud with an exposure of $1,926.93 under an undocumented pattern. In response to this activity, the bank has executed a created case and escalated the matter to an analyst, while recommending the L1 action to block the card and the L2 action to file this report.
